Dying deposition , dying declaration.question: 1) A statement made by a dying person about the cause or circumstances of death is called:
Dying deposition , dying declaration.exp: Dying declaration is the statement of a person who is dying and unable to appear later as a witness. It is accepted as evidence in court.

Dying deposition , dying declaration.question: 2) Dying deposition is recorded by:
Dying deposition , dying declaration.exp: Dying deposition is recorded by a magistrate. It is taken in the presence of the accused and their lawyer.

Dying deposition , dying declaration.question: 3) Dying declaration may be recorded by:
Dying deposition , dying declaration.exp: Dying declaration can be recorded by any person. Its evidentiary value is higher when recorded by a magistrate or doctor with witnesses.

Dying deposition , dying declaration.question: 4) Oath is taken in:
Dying deposition , dying declaration.exp: Dying deposition is recorded on oath. Dying declaration is not recorded under oath.

Dying deposition , dying declaration.question: 5) Cross-examination is allowed in:
Dying deposition , dying declaration.exp: In dying deposition, cross-examination is allowed because the accused and lawyer are present. This gives it stronger evidentiary value.

Dying deposition , dying declaration.question: 6) The stronger evidentiary value is seen in:
Dying deposition , dying declaration.exp: Dying deposition is stronger because it is recorded by a magistrate, oath is taken, and cross-examination is allowed.

Dying deposition , dying declaration.question: 7) In Bangladesh, the followed dying statement is:
Dying deposition , dying declaration.exp: The file states that dying declaration is followed in Bangladesh. Dying deposition is not followed in Bangladesh.

Dying deposition , dying declaration.question: 8) Dying deposition is used when the dying person is:
Dying deposition , dying declaration.option1: Fit to give testimony in legal form
Dying deposition , dying declaration.exp: Dying deposition is used when the person is dying but still fit to give testimony legally. It is recorded formally by a magistrate.

Dying deposition , dying declaration.question: 9) Dying declaration is used when the person is:
Dying deposition , dying declaration.option4: Dying and unable to be a witness later
Dying deposition , dying declaration.exp: Dying declaration is used when a dying person may not survive to testify in court. It records the relevant statement before death.

Dying deposition , dying declaration.question: 10) The most valuable dying statement is:
Dying deposition , dying declaration.exp: Dying deposition has greater value because it is recorded by a magistrate under oath, with cross-examination allowed.

Dying deposition , dying declaration.question: 11) Dying declaration recorded by a doctor should ideally be in presence of at least:
Dying deposition , dying declaration.exp: A doctor may record dying declaration in the presence of at least two witnesses. This improves reliability of the statement.

Dying deposition , dying declaration.question: 12) A village headman recording dying declaration gives:
Dying deposition , dying declaration.exp: Village headman, police or any other person can record dying declaration, but its evidential value is less than formal recording.

Dying deposition , dying declaration.question: 13) Locard’s Exchange Principle states:
Dying deposition , dying declaration.exp: Locard’s Exchange Principle means every contact in a crime leaves some trace evidence. It is a basic forensic investigation principle.

Dying deposition , dying declaration.question: 14) “Every crime leaves a trace” is related to:
Dying deposition , dying declaration.exp: Locard’s principle explains transfer of evidence during contact. It links the offender, victim and scene.
